name: check-and-paxos
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check; bun test core/cube-rows.test.ts; mkdir -p parent; tar -xf replay-input/parent.tar -C parent; (cd parent && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null); echo SIDE=parent; (cd parent && timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --only paxos_epr --skip broken --ms 60000); echo SIDE=candidate; timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --only paxos_epr --skip broken --ms 60000
